title: Quietly Smoky Tunisian Lamb Wrap
description: A smoky and flaky Tunisian dish featuring chopped parsley and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, wrapped in a cozy ssam-wrap.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb shoulder in the oven and roast for 2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before shredding it into bite-sized pieces.
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the shredded lamb onto a ssam wrap, followed by a sprinkle of chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
